methodology.reference_dataset: JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History v1.4
methodology.boundary_exclusion: 1-pixel transition band evaluated with and without
methodology.uncertainty: Block-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (10x10 px blocks, B=500)
methodology.reporting_standard: Reported as 'agreement with JRC GSW', never 'accuracy'

aois.hydrological_regime: Inland alluvial plains & agricultural dendritic drainage
Arid desert fringe with small ephemeral impoundments (Kaylana)

instructions:
JRC GSW Monthly History raw observations are distributed via Google Earth Engine asset collection 'JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory'. To execute full raster validation, export the October-November composite for each AOI and place the GeoTIFFs at:
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\raipur_jrc_monthly_2019.tif
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\raipur_jrc_monthly_2020.tif
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\raipur_jrc_monthly_2021.tif
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\bhopal_jrc_monthly_2019.tif
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\bhopal_jrc_monthly_2020.tif
  - data\reference\jrc_gsw\bhopal_jrc_monthly_2021.tif
